requirements.name: Role-based access control enforcement
requirements.summary: The system must restrict system access based on the specific permissions of each actor.

requirements.name: Multi-factor authentication for agents
requirements.summary: The system must require secure verification for gig-workers accessing delivery tools.

requirements.name: Store staff order verification rights
requirements.summary: The system must enable store personnel to validate item quality before dispatch.

requirements.name: Delivery agent capacity management
requirements.summary: The system must allow agents to view and manage their assigned delivery slots.

requirements.name: Customer identity verification workflow
requirements.summary: The system must validate customer identity and contact details during onboarding.

requirements.name: Partner agreement access provisioning
requirements.summary: The system must grant store partners access only to their specific commercial terms.

requirements.name: Regulatory compliance audit logging
requirements.summary: The system must record all actions taken by actors for external regulatory audits.

requirements.name: Dispute resolution authority assignment
requirements.summary: The system must define which actors have the right to approve or reject disputes.
